# Avery Dennison® Announces 2027 Training Schedule


## – Updated class schedule and registration opens Tuesday, November 3 –


MENTOR, Ohio – October 30, 2026 – Avery Dennison® (NYSE:AVY) Graphics Solutions announces its 2027 training and certification exam schedule on November 3, the first day of SEMA 2026. The expert-led workshops provide in-depth, hands-on instruction with a wide range of films, including Vehicle Color Change Wrapping Films, Commercial Wraps, Advanced Wrap Training, Wet-Apply and Dry-Apply Paint Protection Film, and Automotive and Safety & Solar Window Film.


An industry-leader for training and application instruction, Avery Dennison will also offer certification exams in vehicle wraps and architectural window films specific to safety and solar films, to help advanced and expert installers enhance credibility and boost income.


The class schedule and open registration will be available at[graphics.averydennison.com/training](http://graphics.averydennison.com/training) beginning on Tuesday, November 3.


Avery Dennison professional trainer and commander-in-chief of Brand Command, Blake Madsen, instructs students on the art of commercial vehicle wraps during this hands-on installation class.


Chris Figueroa, Avery Dennison professional trainer, and owner and installer at Bay Image, instructs a student on the specific methods for applying paint protection film to a vehicle’s surface.


**New Classes and Learning Opportunities for 2027:**


- **Color Change Vehicle Wrap Training –** Designed to provide beginners and intermediate installers with a variety of wrapping and customization opportunities, this innovative workshop will cover both Supreme Wrapping Film™ and PrismaPro™ dry-apply color PPF.
- **Safety & Solar Film Training and Certification Exam –** Now with even more dates and locations, the class will train installers in interior and exterior solar films, plus safety window films. After completing the two-day workshop, installers can boost their brands by becoming Avery Dennison Certified.
- **Other commercial wrap, wet-apply paint protection film, and advanced wrap training courses will continue in 2027 –** with even more availability and convenience because new training locations will be added near Cincinnati, Seattle and Denver.
- **The Online Business Bootcamp –** A five-part video series from experts John Duever and Justin Pate, provides the blueprints to build a scalable, profitable operation. Automotive restyling shop pros can learn how to create SOPs, optimize workflows and implement profitable pricing strategies – all from the convenient comfort of their own laptops.


Also in 2027, Avery Dennison will continue to offer its smaller wrap training class sizes to allow more personal instruction and hands-on time for each student


“Attendees to our expert-led workshops get real, hands-on opportunities that support all experience levels,” said Graeme McKnight, Marketing Program Associate at Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions. “By training with an Avery Dennison specialist, participants will learn valuable skills that consistently distinguish professionals and drive sales.”


Justin Pate, Avery Dennison professional trainer and owner of The Wrap Institute, has led color change vehicle wrap classes for Avery Dennison since 2010.


Architectural window film installation offers graphic shops an opportunity to expand their service offering beyond vehicles and signage. Harold Nimtz, Avery Dennison professional trainer and owner of House of Tint, shares his installation prowess with students during the Safety & Solar Film training


Avery Dennison training sessions offer live demonstrations and hands-on practice with trusted, experienced trainers. 90% of each course focuses on hands-on learning to improve cutting skills, learn material properties, and refine installation techniques.


Continuing education is also an economical investment for smart installers. Many classes provide participants with a free roll of film, free installation tools, and a 30% discount on a one-year membership to The Wrap Institute for wrap and commercial wrap classes.


For more information about the 2027 Avery Dennison installation training and certification classes, go to[graphics.averydennison.com/training](http://graphics.averydennison.com/training) beginning November 3, 2026. Or join the conversation on Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions’ social channels, including[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/AveryDennisonGraphics/) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/adgraphics_na/?hl=en) .


**About Avery Dennison**


**#MakingPossible**


Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries.
